name: 6 Card Omaha
description: 6 Card Omaha: six hole cards each, five community cards. Use exactly two hole cards and three board cards for best five-card hand. Pot Limit common; more drawing and stronger hands than 4-card Omaha. 2-9 players.

content.text: 6 Card Omaha: six hole cards each, five community cards. Use exactly two hole cards and three board cards for best five-card hand. Pot Limit common; more drawing and stronger hands than 4-card Omaha. 2-9 players.

Omaha poker is a relatively recent casino variant that emerged in the USA in the early 1980s. Six Card Omaha is a modern "Big O" extension in which each player is dealt six hole cards but must still use exactly two hole cards and three board cards at showdown.
Two to nine players. Optimal four to six.

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
Six hole cards each, face down; then five community cards (flop three, turn one, river one). Dealing clockwise.

items.text: Six Card Omaha High: Standard version; only the best high hand wins the pot. Pot Limit common.
Pot Limit vs No Limit: Pot Limit: maximum bet or raise equals current pot size. No Limit: any amount up to stack.
